description: Exports one or more CIVIL NX tables (each like the preview_result_table arguments, full scope, no sampling) into one Excel workbook built by the exporter plugin: one sheet per table (and per sub-table; split above 1,048,575 rows), unit-labelled headers, numeric cells, and a 'Contents & Export Log' sheet listing each table's request, rows and any failure. format csv gives one CSV file per sheet instead. Returns download links (never the file inline) and a per-table summary; a table that fails is logged and the rest still export. Read-only. Can run long on big models, so it runs as a job on the website.

includeContents.description: Add the 'Contents & Export Log' sheet first.

argument.description: For custom-table: the full POST /post/TABLE Argument object.

columns.description: Model tables: exact column names to keep (preview first to see them).

components.description: Columns, as listed for the table (e.g. Axial, Moment-y). Omit for the plugin's defaults; for 'all columns' tables omit for every column.

constructionStage.description: Results of the construction stage analysis (adds Stage and Step columns).

dbKey.description: For db-custom: any /db/ key (e.g. MVHL, TDNA).

value.description: ids: "1-40, 52"; range: "1 to 250"; group: the structure group name.

extraArgument.description: For 'all columns' tables: more POST /post/TABLE Argument keys (e.g. LOAD_CASE_NAMES, NODE_ELEMS, OPT_CS).

nodeCenter.description: Plate tables: include the element centre.

nodeCorners.description: Plate tables: include the corner nodes (default true).

parts.description: Beam tables: stations along each element (default PartI, PartJ).

records.description: Model tables: which record ids (filtered after the read).

sectionPositions.description: Beam stress detail: e.g. ["Maximum"] or stress point numbers.

stageSteps.description: With constructionStage: e.g. ["CS1:001(first)", "CS3:002(last)"]. Omit for every saved step.

table.description: Table id from result_table_catalog (e.g. reaction-global, beam-force, displacement-global, plate-force-unit-local, db-node). A MIDAS TABLE_TYPE (BEAMFORCE) or DB key (NODE) is accepted too.

units.description: Units MIDAS converts the results to (default kN, m).

userTableName.description: For user-defined-table-*: the saved Dynamic Report Table name.

name: export_result_tables
title: Export result and model tables to Excel
